history.overview: The Inner Sanctum is the Ocean God’s core domain, where divine water rites were performed and planar energy concentrated.

timeline.name: Sanctum Constructed
timeline.description: Built as the Ocean God’s most sacred chamber.

timeline.name: Planar Water Conduits Activated
timeline.description: Conduits were used to channel concentrated oceanic planar energy.

timeline.name: Discord Corruption
timeline.description: Discord ruptures destabilized the sanctum’s divine architecture.

timeline.name: Muramite Assault
timeline.description: Muramite forces attempted to breach the sanctum’s defenses.
